title: doctor's view-skew finding on a hand edit the store can carry back names only the discarding sync --to-disk
body:
Found on 2026-09-24 by vc's subagent driving `docs/getting-started.md` for the 3.2.1 doc audit, in a scratch project under an isolated HOME on the pair at `4c687eaad`; vc read the capture.

Seen: after a hand edit to a thread's `## Objective` in `intent/st/ST0001/info.md` -- one of the two sections `intent sync --to-store` carries back into the store -- `intent doctor` exits 1 with `residue: view-skew`. Its remedy line warns that "regenerating a view DISCARDS a hand edit, so copy anything you meant to keep out first", and the finding names only `intent sync --to-disk`, which regenerates the view from the store and discards the edit. `intent sync --to-store` carries the edit (after it, `intent st show` prints the new objective and doctor reports no finding), and doctor never names it. `intent st show` keeps printing the old objective until the edit is carried.

Why it matters: the finding is counted, so the pre-commit gate refuses the next commit, and the only way out it names discards what the author just wrote. The loss is announced rather than silent, which is why this sits below 0554, where the discarded text is a teammate's message the reader has never seen.

Expected: a view-skew finding on a view whose difference lies in sections the store can carry back names the carrying verb first, and `--to-disk` only as the way to discard.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- it is the same doctor finding site as 0554's part (b), so it rides with that change if hv rules it into 3.2.1, and otherwise it is filed for after the stabilisation line. The getting-started page names `intent sync --to-store` as the step that carries an `info.md` edit, as built.
